title: Keep state for a removed component

slides.say: A chat app: switch from Alice to Bob and back. Alice’s draft is gone. How do you keep it?
Option one: render every chat, and hide the others with CSS. Nothing is removed, so state stays. Simple, but slow if the hidden trees are big.
Option two, the most common: lift the state up. The parent keeps a draft for each contact, so removing the child does not matter.

slides.text: 3. Also save to localStorage, so a draft survives closing the page.
slides.say: Option three: use another source too, like local storage, so drafts survive even when the page closes.
